symptom.yue: 張紙上面寫，如果坐喺度乜都冇做都唞唔到氣。
symptom.cmn: 这张纸上写着，如果坐着不动都气促、喘不上气。
symptom.en: The sheet says: if she is short of breath while sitting still.

action.yue: 就即刻去急症室，唔好等。
action.cmn: 就马上去急诊室，不要等。
action.en: go straight to A&E — don't wait.

source.quote: 1. If you are short of breath while sitting still, go to the Accident & Emergency Department at once.

symptom.yue: 張紙上面寫，如果兩隻腳踝又腫返。
symptom.cmn: 这张纸上写着，如果两只脚踝又肿起来。
symptom.en: The sheet says: if both ankles swell up again.

action.yue: 就即刻去急症室，唔好等。
action.cmn: 就马上去急诊室，不要等。
action.en: go straight to A&E — don't wait.

source.quote: 2. If both ankles swell again, go to the Accident & Emergency Department at once.

symptom.yue: 張紙上面寫，如果三日之內重咗超過兩公斤。
symptom.cmn: 这张纸上写着，如果三天之内体重多了超过两公斤。
symptom.en: The sheet says: if her weight goes up by more than 2 kg in three days.

action.yue: 就即刻去急症室，唔好等。
action.cmn: 就马上去急诊室，不要等。
action.en: go straight to A&E — don't wait.

source.quote: 3. If your weight goes up more than 2 kg in three days, go to the Accident & Emergency Department at once.

spoken.yue: Frusemide 20mg，一粒，每朝早食一次，食 28 日。
spoken.cmn: Frusemide 20mg，一片，每天早上吃一次，吃 28 天。
spoken.en: Frusemide 20mg, 1 tab, once every morning, for 28 days.

source.quote: 1 Frusemide 20mg 1 tab Daily in the morning 28 days

spoken.yue: Metoprolol 25mg，一粒，一日兩次，食 28 日。BD 喺張紙上面即係一日兩次。
spoken.cmn: Metoprolol 25mg，一片，一天两次，吃 28 天。纸上的 BD 就是一天两次。
spoken.en: Metoprolol 25mg, 1 tab, twice a day, for 28 days. BD on the sheet means twice a day.

spoken.yue: Ramipril 2.5mg，一粒，每日一次，食 28 日。
spoken.cmn: Ramipril 2.5mg，一片，每天一次，吃 28 天。
spoken.en: Ramipril 2.5mg, 1 tab, once a day, for 28 days.

spoken.yue: Atorvastatin 40mg，一粒，每晚一次，食 28 日。Nocte 喺張紙上面即係夜晚食。
spoken.cmn: Atorvastatin 40mg，一片，每晚一次，吃 28 天。纸上的 Nocte 就是晚上吃。
spoken.en: Atorvastatin 40mg, 1 tab, once at night, for 28 days. Nocte on the sheet means at night.

spoken.yue: Paracetamol 500mg，膝頭痛嗰陣先食，每次一至兩粒，一日最多四次，總共 20 粒。
spoken.cmn: Paracetamol 500mg，膝盖痛的时候才吃，每次一到两片，一天最多四次，一共 20 片。
spoken.en: Paracetamol 500mg, only when the knee hurts, 1 to 2 tabs each time, up to four times a day, 20 tabs in all.

source.quote: 5 Paracetamol 500mg 1-2 tabs QID PRN for knee pain 20 tabs

spoken.en: The second page says: come back to the 內科專科門診 clinic on 14-10-2026, a Wednesday, at 9:30 in the morning.

spoken.cmn: 这张纸饮食那一行写着：低盐，吃饭不要再加盐，饮水每天最多一升半。
spoken.en: The food line on the sheet says: low salt, no extra salt at the table, and up to 1.5 litres of fluid a day.

activityLine.text: Activity: light walking at home with a stick. No heavy lifting and no stair climbing for 4 weeks.

spoken.yue: 張紙寫住：喺屋企攞住支拐杖慢慢行下就得，四個星期內唔好搬重嘢，亦唔好行樓梯。
spoken.cmn: 这张纸上写着：在家里拄着拐杖慢慢走就好，四周内不要提重物，也不要爬楼梯。
spoken.en: The sheet says: light walking at home with a stick, and no heavy lifting or stairs for four weeks.

source.quote: 2. Activity: light walking at home with a stick. No heavy lifting and no stair climbing for 4 weeks.
